data.title: Invideo Launches Research Grants for Working Filmmakers
data.description:
# Invideo Launches Research Grants for Working Filmmakers
**The program funds filmmaker-led experiments in how AI fits the craft: discovered on real projects, not designed in a lab.**

Invideo, the AI video platform for serious creatives, today launched **invideo Research Grants**, a funding program for working filmmakers to run the experiments productions & credits never leave room for, and to publish what they discover under their own names.

Earlier this year, the company hosted the inaugural India AI Film Festival in New Delhi and announced an $11 million partnership with Abundantia Entertainment's aiON division to launch an AI-driven film studio, with a slate of five films in development over three years.
